doc.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26

title: Manetta travels to Los Angeles and the Cadillac opens
summary: The train trip west, the advertising truck, the packed Cadillac at 5th and Central, and a packed house.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: So, alright. We started playing that night, playing all them numbers and you know Wade had a habit when he was talking. Y'all used to call him Busher. So, alright. He said, you know something? Man, if I had a lineup like this, go to California, Cali. Cali, we clean up. I said, let me tell you, a white band right around the corner of my house. He was begging for a band. I'm there. Oh man. I said, leave any time. Yeah? Now I'm playing at Walter's Place. Alright. Got together. Pop a mug, pop a mug, pop a mug, roll a mug. Well, he could spell. Wade could be nice. Alright. Guess Alfred Williams? After little Mac Hill was playing out there, stuck a gun. He was on his feet and died. They go and get Mac, they ask me who did I like. I told them, well Alfred Williams kept a good time. He was Sam Morgan, so they go down. I said, now listen, how you gonna do this boy's band, this boy kid now? I said, I'm just playing here this father and son in my last week with this boy. Wade said, I'll get old man George McCullen to go out and play all but his piano player. Walter's coming back on the job. Alright. So everything's alright. One or two they'll say, let's pee, where's the runner? They was fixing the road. We went over on a teepee. Made us a little late. So, I wouldn't say nothing to them boys, mucking them. Nothing. About Lewis and all them got cold feet. They don't know what they were going to do. So, there we go. They get out there when the train, get to California. What I done, I grab my grip and get ahead of them dudes you know. Where horse at? Where horse? They was way behind me. Where horse? I want to get off first so I can see or it expand, alright. So yeah, I get off, yeah, they were way behind me. When they get off, they're out there and they're out there. They're all ready. He's locked. I'm looking down. I can see, I can see, alright. I say, alright. I don't say nothing until I speak to you. I said, alright. Or else, ain't that Papa Mark? I said, yeah. He's looking at you. He's seeing a little black fella coming. Ain't that Boucher? I said, yeah. I see that little fella coming. Ain't that average? So, we're right across from the Cadillac. So, I said, won't send him to the Cadillac. Well, Lord, got, ooh, of course. We got on the dress roll, and I said, you know something? He said, God, sir, it's good. He said that them men did come. So, we started playing. Now, all the shows with the man. Ha-ha. We done in Yardins. Make an advertisement. Which houses out in California at that time? You see a two-story house with gyres on them? Them dudes was blocked in with a block. They never sat on their porch upstairs. They had an old guy out here who was waiting for the lockers. They called him Chappy Henderson. Master Ceremony. So, Ory explained, get a truck. We used to get, we used to have two mules pulling the furniture wagon when we'd advertise. Ory explained, go hark in the truck, all right? One got a big old truck back on the truck. Put the piano in the truck. Chappy says, I'll know, I'll work to him just to go on in good spots, you know. All right. I went to Manor, big old house there, and blockhead it. People never been one of that guy since he's been out there. He's born ripped, Chappy Henderson. And, oh, we got one in the corner, the striker, brown skin, who you for? And then people upstairs, come on, bust the door down. I never heard any music like that. Well, that's all right. We made it out of time. What part of town was that? In Los Angeles. What part of town was it? Right across the city, that point, 5th to Central. We didn't get to Hollywood, but the
news got out there, you know. And all the movies started, you know. So, we made it out of time.
You know that night? That's where the money was, you know. All that night, Mr. Jack?
But in fact, we planted money there and away with everyone. The place was packed like sardines.
